jarnvag_: Day 6: Karel "Brick" Jarnvag reached S-S10 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Karel "Brick" Jarnvag and Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home found Karel "Brick" Jarnvag before the night shift. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag folded it small and kept it close.

Karel "Brick" Jarnvag wrote a letter for Tobias Avtomat's mother, because Tobias could not find the words. Tobias signed it. A letter from home found Karel "Brick" Jarnvag before the night shift. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag folded it small and kept it close.
Karel "Brick" Jarnvag started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."

The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag approved the method. A letter from home found Karel "Brick" Jarnvag before the night shift. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag folded it small and kept it close.
khattabka_: Quentin Khattabka came up on Day 4 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Quentin Khattabka was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Quentin Khattabka in the open at S-F3. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Cyril "Ash" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Quentin Khattabka was carried in at last. The worst has passed for Quentin Khattabka. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Quentin Khattabka looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A surgeon stopped at Quentin Khattabka's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The medical officer cleared Quentin Khattabka for duty. At S-F3, someone quietly moved a pack off his usual seat.

Quentin Khattabka spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Quentin Khattabka added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
lord_punchworth: Karel Punchworth unpacked a tin of tobacco at R-F22. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Karel Punchworth tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F22 is up. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F22. Karel Punchworth has learned to walk bent double.

Someone asked Karel Punchworth to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Punchworth censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.
Karel Punchworth checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.

Leopold Mrsmidgeyt of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near the Chalk Pits. Karel Punchworth of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.
micro_sergio: The new rifleman is Jakub "Whistle" Sergio, once a postman from Halden. The corporal asked if a postman was any use in a trench. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio said he would find out.
miked8903: The quartermaster asked Jonas Miked to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Jonas Miked helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Jonas Miked and Nils Makinekivanc carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
A bullet found Jonas Miked at R-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Severin Sky of the Hegemony (@the_ghost_of_sky).

Jonas Miked drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Jonas Miked watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
There was never a bed for Jonas Miked, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F8 on his own feet.
Jonas Miked and Bastian Szko tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
A bullet grazed Jonas Miked's ribs at R-F8. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Teodor Shadowizard of the Hegemony (@shadowizard__).
Jonas Miked no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
saam_1z: Valentin "Spark" Saam was a brewer in Wyvern Cross until the posters went up. He came to R-S15 with a book with the last pages torn out, and within a day the whole squad knew that he keeps feeding the rats.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Valentin "Spark" Saam changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
